notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for the standard joined-federate MOM HLAdirectedInteractionsSent value and its relationship to HLAinteractionsSent. It uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, HLAinteger32BE, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application class/member names. One ordinary send must increase only the total counter; three directed sends are checked through the total and directed scalar values, followed by direct and periodic checks after two more directed sends. The FOM uses standard directed-interaction declarations without DDM regions. The test does not claim the DDM-related accounting semantics of HLAinteractionsSent. No provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics are used.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador joined-federate MOM value requests, object-class publication/subscription, ordinary and directed interaction publication/subscription and sends, object registration, HLAsetTiming control, with FederateAmbassador discovery, reflection, ordinary receive, and directed receive callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador MOM, object-management, directed-interaction, callback, and HLAinteger32BE declarations
